High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Order 
Petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India challenging orders dated 20.12.2024 and 10.09.2024 contained in Annexure-P/1 and P/2 respectively.

2. Counsel appearing for petitioner submitted that Collector has dismissed his application on grounds that petitioner is having right to file an application directly before the authority and get his grievances ventilated.
After rejection of application, petitioner approached authority for entertaining his reference.
Said application has also been dismissed.

3. Heard the counsel for the parties.
4.

Considering the provisions of Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013, Collector ought to have referred the matter to authority within period of 30 days.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
If Collector fails to make such reference within aforesaid period, then parties are also at liberty to file application NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:5932 2 WP-3421-2025 directly before authority who can give direction to Collector to make reference and send it to the authority.
In these circumstances, petition is allowed.
Impugned orders dated 20.12.2024 and 10.09.2024 are quashed.
Collector is directed to send reference to the authority for adjudication.
